
QUERY-METRICS
Query project metrics and statistics

USAGE
  fspec query-metrics [options]

OPTIONS
  --metric <metric>
    Specific metric to query
  --format <format>
    Output format: table or json
  --work-unit-id <id>
    Specific work unit to query metrics for

EXAMPLES
  1. Show all metrics
  $ fspec query-metrics
  Velocity: 23 points/week
Cycle time: 3.5 days avg
Throughput: 5 work units/week

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec generate-summary-report
